description: This file contains PHPUnit unit tests for the CleanCSV class in the SuiteCRM project. It defines the CleanCSVTest class, which includes setup and test methods for various functionalities of the CleanCSV class.

classes.name: CleanCSVTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the methods of the CleanCSV class within the SuiteCRM project.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and creates a new instance of the CleanCSV class before each test.

methods.name: testGetEscapeChar
methods.description: Tests that the getEscapeChar method returns the expected escape character: "'".

methods.name: testGetStartingChars
methods.description: Tests that the getStartingChars method returns the correct array of characters ['=', '-', '+', '@'].

methods.name: testEscapeField
methods.description: Verifies that the escapeField method correctly prepends a single quote to the input string '==HYPERLINK'.
